user_locked: The two characters and the staging come from 图1: a young man and a young woman in that indoor kitchen, the man in front of the sink at frame centre-right and the woman at frame left, with their face, hair and body appearance kept stable.

Action order: the man hands a washed dish to the woman at frame left; he then turns and suddenly flings dishwashing foam with his right hand toward the woman at the left edge of the frame; she is startled and immediately counterattacks; the two then playfully splash foam at each other and dodge.
The characters' body movement, gestures, dynamic facial expressions and performance rhythm strictly follow 输入视频1, transferred onto the two characters from 图1.
Audible laughter from both characters during the foam exchange.

video_1 supplies the performance of a two-person kitchen interaction: plate hand-off, a sudden turn-and-fling beat, reciprocal foam throwing with dodging, and the facial-expression and beat timing that go with it, presented as one continuous real-time interaction in medium framing.

The resting state of the plate she keeps holding and of the counter props during the exchange.
Shot count, framing scale, camera behaviour and cut placement.
The ending: the exchange is still in progress at the final frame, both laughing, with no resolution inserted.

developments.visible_change: In the kitchen of 图1, the young man stands in front of the sink at frame centre-right with a freshly washed white plate held over the basin while the young woman waits at frame left with her hands open; following the gesture phrasing and tempo of 输入视频1, he lifts the plate, leans half a step toward her and extends it across the counter, and she takes it with both hands and settles it against her chest.
developments.outcome: The woman at frame left now holds the wet plate; the man's hands are free over the sink; both characters remain in their original staging.

developments.visible_change: The man turns back to the sink, dips his right hand into the basin and gathers a fistful of white sudsy foam, then snaps his body around and whips his right arm across his torso, flinging the foam toward the woman at the left edge of the frame; the clump breaks apart in the air and the largest piece strikes her cheek and black top.
developments.outcome: Foam is smeared across the woman's cheek, jaw and shoulder and drips onto the plate and counter, while the man's wet right hand stays extended over the basin and he starts laughing.

developments.visible_change: The woman's head snaps back with wide eyes and an open mouth at the impact, and the startle immediately turns into laughter; she leans in over the counter, scoops a fistful of foam from the sink basin with her free right hand and hurls it back at the man, and it bursts against his chest and left shoulder.
developments.outcome: Foam speckles the man's white t-shirt and shoulder; the woman still holds the plate in her left hand; both face each other across the sink, laughing and ready to continue.

developments.visible_change: The two trade further clumps in quick alternation, scooping from the basin and throwing in one motion, the man ducking behind his raised shoulder and the woman leaning sideways so that foam sails past her shoulder and slaps the cabinet behind her; both keep laughing loudly and moving only inside the sink-and-counter area of the same staging.
developments.outcome: At the final frame the exchange is still in progress: both characters stand foam-flecked in the original staging, faces and hair speckled, the man with foam dripping from his right hand and the woman's throwing arm still raised, both laughing.

shots.content_purpose: Establish the kitchen staging and the two identities, show the washed-dish hand-off, then the man's turn back to the sink and his sudden right-hand fling of foam toward the woman.
shots.description: The shot opens on the staging of <Picture 1>: <Subject 1> stands in front of the stainless-steel sink at frame centre-right with a freshly washed white plate held above the basin, and <Subject 2> stands at frame left facing him with her hands open. Following the gesture phrasing and unhurried tempo of <Video 1>, <Subject 1> lifts the plate, leans half a step toward frame left and extends it across the counter; <Subject 2> takes it with both hands and settles it against her black top, and the wet plate clicks softly as it changes hands. <Subject 1> turns back to the sink, dips his right hand into the basin and gathers a fistful of white sudsy foam. The camera holds a steady medium two-shot on the staging, then pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as <Subject 1> suddenly snaps his body around and whips his right arm across his torso, flinging the foam toward frame left; the clump breaks apart in the air and the largest piece flies straight at <Subject 2>'s face.

shots.content_purpose: Show the woman's startled facial reaction at the moment of impact, her immediate counterattack, and the mutual playful foam exchange with dodging and laughter up to the final frame.
shots.cut_reason: The required startle beat (wide eyes, head snap, open mouth before laughter) is too small to read in the establishing medium two-shot, and the observation emphasis shifts from the man's hand-off at the sink to the woman's face at frame left; a closer framing across the sink is needed to see the foam strike and that expression without losing the man.
shots.continuity_bridge: The foam clump already in flight at the end of Shot 1 lands on the woman's cheek in the first frame of Shot 2; the man's right arm is still extended low over the basin from the throw, the plate stays in the woman's left hand at her chest, and both characters keep their positions and their wet, foam-flecked surfaces.
shots.description: At 00:06.400, the shot cuts to a closer medium two-shot angled across the sink, favouring <Subject 2> at frame left with <Subject 1> at frame centre-right and his right arm still extended over the basin. Following the facial-expression timing of <Video 1>, the foam splatters across her cheek, jaw and shoulder, her head jerks back, her eyes fly wide and her mouth drops open before the yelp breaks into laughter, and wet foam drips from her chin onto the plate she still holds at her chest. <Subject 1> laughs out loud as his shoulder loosens; <Subject 2> leans in over the counter, scoops a fistful of foam from the sink basin with her free right hand and hurls it back, and the clump bursts against his chest and left shoulder in a wet spatter that speckles his white t-shirt while he flinches back, still laughing. The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed to keep both in frame as they keep trading clumps: he ducks behind his raised shoulder, she leans sideways and a clump sails past her shoulder and slaps the cabinet behind her, and she scoops and throws again. Both laugh loudly on every throw. The shot holds on the two of them still going at the end of the video, foam-flecked faces and hair, the man with foam dripping from his right hand and the woman's throwing arm still raised.
